item.title: Props Are Not a Design System
item.description: Most UI kits let you pass any style as a prop — radius, size, color, or a wall of Tailwind classes, whatever you need. That flexibility is exactly the problem: it turns every component call into a one-off styling decision, and no two buttons end up the same. Let's talk about practices that prevent building an inconsistent, unmaintainable code base that won't scale.
